content.short: Cardanime Coins is a story-driven CNFT project inspired by anime and mythology that brings coin collecting into the modern age.
content.description:
Inspired by anime, mythology, sci-fi and fantasy, Cardanime Coins is a limited mint CNFT project that has evolved from a parody project focusing on character coins as an ode to anime history into a story driven project focusing on a multiverse and wide range of inter-connected stories - Cardanime Coins: Kamigami.

Cardanime Coins are a divine currency that has been traded amongst the Gods since the dawn of time. Originally used as a means to store power to endow their loyal followers with a fraction of their power, the discovery of the multiverse created a new purpose.

Cardanime Coins: Kamigami begins with the Greek Pantheon and will progress its story with each drop and aims to cover different mythos and legends that have already been story boarded. Each design is hand drawn with a unique chibi anime style consisting of a unique coin, character, skin and background. A low mint number of 501 NFTs mean that holders will receieve a unique 1 of 1 NFT from a large amount of possible design combinations.

Cardanime Coins: Kamigami rewards holders by offering Manga Covers, ADA rewards and Collectible Credit Cards to build a community that can really invest in our story plans for the future.
